installed_via: manual (DSH integration is not in the specify CLI catalog; installed by hand to mirror opencode)
notes: Parallel integration alongside opencode. Default integration remains opencode (NON-NEGOTIABLE — do not flip default_integration to dsh).
Files are byte-identical to .opencode/commands/speckit.*.md (sha256 match) because spec-kit slash-command markdown is agent-agnostic and works against .specify/templates/*.md.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) does not currently auto-load .dsh/commands/ as slash commands; these files are used either via the specify CLI workflow runner or by asking the DSH agent to read the file.
